message.content: In one of the discussions, Turalyon expressed interest in hearing everyone's thoughts on limiting noisy activities during the early afternoon hours, specifically from 2-3 PM. He mentioned planning to stick to their schedule and limit such activities during that timeframe, and he asked if putting up temporary barriers or using quieter tools during that period would be a good idea. Additionally, Turalyon suggested notifying residents a day in advance about any particularly loud work, which he thought would help them plan around it. He was keen on getting input from the community to ensure the renovation process would be as smooth and as accommodating to residents as possible.
